limitations: The static engine was extracted from the supplied original executable, while the selected cracked launcher includes Enigma. No claim that all wrappers or patches are byte-identical.

string_payload_contract.encoded_caption_after_owner: 0x5c owns the next marker+rawNUL payload and unconditionally applies byte+32/$space. All74 actual choice captions use marker6C (seven other6C records are87 UI payloads); standalone6C remains dispatch default. Its own raw string is the choice label.5F skips another following raw string and is not a caption opcode.
